visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair, wearing a black tank top and shorts, stands in front of an open wooden wardrobe with glass panels. He turns back to the camera. The setting is a brightly lit indoor bedroom. (2) The scene cuts to a parking garage; the man stands beside a red car, opening the door. He wears a black backpack. (3) The man is seen in the same garage, looking directly into the camera and gesturing with both hands open in an exaggerated, welcoming manner. (4) A night scene on a scooter; both the man and a woman are wearing black helmets. The woman makes a peace sign toward the camera. (5) In a hallway, the man enters through a doorway carrying cardboard boxes, smiling and pointing one finger at the camera. (6) In a modern kitchen, the man claps his hands and gives two thumbs up with a wide, joyful grin. (7) Back on the scooter during the day, the couple is riding. The man smiles while looking at the camera through the mirror or selfie angle, and the woman leans her head on his shoulder.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A man's voice says 'Bao~~' with a soft, affectionate tone over a light acoustic guitar rhythm. (2) A female voice asks a question followed by a loud, high-pitched male exclamation 'Ni chao piao liang!' with significant pitch modulation. A 'pop' bubble SFX is heard. (3) The man speaks in a formal, slightly comical deep voice while the car door thuds shut. (4) Sound of a scooter engine humming at a low frequency. A camera shutter SFX triggers a female giggle. (5) Fast-paced vocal exchange with the man repeatedly saying '100 fen' in varying high-arousal tones, punctuated by cartoonish 'ding' and 'pop' transition SFX. (6) The acoustic guitar music continues as the man delivers a rapid-fire sentimental speech, maintaining a high pitch and friendly tone. (7) Final female scream of excitement and laughter as the audio fades quickly.
